question: Find the value of 70³ + 20³ - 90³.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

We know that a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc if a + b + c = 0

703 + 203- 903

= 703 + 203 + (- 90)3

= 3 × 70 × 20 × (- 90) [∵ 70 + 20 + (- 90) = 0]

= - 378000

∴ The value of the given expression is - 378000

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The given expression = 703 + 203- 903

**Calculation:**

703 + 203- 903

= 343000 + 8000 - 729000

= 351000 - 729000

= - 378000

**∴ The value of the given expression is - 378000**
